messages:
Alex: Scheduling a schema migration + backfill for orders.orders_v2 on Friday 2026-03-20 at 23:00 PT. Need someone to own the deploy window, smoke checks, and rollback readiness.

Marta: I can take the deploy window (23:00-01:00 PT). Ill be on-call that night. Would like to run a full staging run earlier today to validate timings.

Samir: Whats the expected backfill volume? Last time 100M rows was a long job. Ill run a dry run in staging and post exact batch timings.

Jia: If we add a nullable column and backfill async, we might avoid a long dual-write, but reads could be inconsistent for a short period. Id prefer a feature-flagged dual-write for ~30-45m just to be safe.

Alex: Plan suggestion: enable dual-write for 45m, then flip reads to orders_v2 after smoke validation. Rollback = feature-flag off + quick revert of the write shim. Also capture pre-migration snapshots of hot partitions.

Samir: Dry-run commands Ill run in staging and post timings:
```
-- estimate recent rows
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '90 days';
-- backfill dry run
python backfill.py --table orders_v2 --batch-size 4000 --limit 1000000
```
Ill post ETA within 45m.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @Marta for 1769823456 (prod migration window 2026-03-20 23:00 PT). React :eyes: to claim smoke checks.

Marta: Claiming deploy. Ill run the migration and monitor the backfill. @Samir, you do smoke validation. @Jia, coordinate the dual-write toggle and middleware canary. Alex you hold the rollback flag.

Samir: Smoke validation checklist Ill run right after backfill finishes:
- API health: GET /health (all services)
- Read tests: SELECT id FROM orders_v2 WHERE id IN (sample ids)
- Write-through: create order end-to-end and confirm presence in both tables
- Latency: compare p50/p95 to baseline
- Quick analytics spot-check (counts for last hour)

Jia: Ill push the middleware change to canary first and then enable dual-write in prod for the window. Will ensure feature-flag switch is safe and atomic.

Alex: Staging rehearsal today at 18:00 PT. Marta runs the full migration+backfill in staging; Samir validates and posts CPU/IO peaks and duration. If prod backfill looks like it will exceed 60m we abort and resume with smaller batches.

Marta: Agreed. Rollback owner = Alex. Escalation path: oncall-db pager if replication lag > 2m or error rate spike. Ill create a short runbook snippet and drop it in /runbooks/migrations after the staging run.

Samir: Staging dry-run results: 12M rows backfilled in 9m with batch-size 4000. Extrapolated prod ETA ~36m. Peak DB CPU ~62% on primary. Sample log:
```
[2026-03-18 18:09:03] backfill batch 300/3000 - 1.8s
[2026-03-18 18:09:05] backfill batch 301/3000 - 1.9s
```
Will tune batch size if we see higher contention.

Alex: Good numbers. Final owners/checklist for Friday:
- Marta: run migration + backfill (owner)
- Samir: smoke checks + script (owner)
- Jia: dual-write toggle + middleware canary (owner)
- Alex: rollback authority + monitoring dashboard
- oncall-db: pager for replication/lag issues

Marta: Ill post the staging run artifacts here after 18:00 and create the calendar invite for 23:00 PT with the runbook and escalation contacts.

Samir: Ill convert the smoke checklist into a small CI job so we can run it immediately after the backfill completes.

Alex: Thanks all  If no objections by EOD Ill lock the slot and send invites. :thumbsup:
